HomePage.heroDescription: Studentersamfunnet i Bergen is the student house in Bergen and one of Norway's most active cultural venues. Every year, more than 1,500 events are arranged, all run by about 500 volunteer students. We have three bars that are entirely volunteer-operated as well as countless groups that cover students' different interests and needs. Samfunnet is a meeting place for students across Bergen, whether it is for morning coffee or a late night out.

LaunchGroups.name: Skjenkegruppen
LaunchGroups.eyebrow: Bar, café, kitchen and cocktail bar
LaunchGroups.lead: Skjenkegruppen is Kvarteret's cooks, servers and bartenders. Here you run the house's permanent bars and kitchen, become part of the largest working group in the house, and receive training along the way whether you want to learn coffee, food, beer or cocktails.

accordionSections.title: Time commitment
paragraphs: Most sub-groups work about one shift per week. Halvtimen stands out with three shifts per month.
A trial shift is the natural way to start if you want to get a feel for the atmosphere before deciding.

accordionSections.title: Sub-groups
paragraphs: Stjernesalen suits you if you want to work with café service, coffee, mocktails and wine.
Kokkegruppen is for those who want to cook for the house and contribute to catering for events and concerts.
Halvtimen is the cocktail bar for those over 20 who want to dive deeper into cocktails, while Grøndahls is the pub with tempo, range and a lot of volunteer life after shifts.

detailSections.title: About the group
paragraphs: Skjenkegruppen is Kvarteret's cooks, servers and bartenders. They run the house's permanent bars and kitchen, and at the same time make up the largest working group at Kvarteret.
That makes the group a place where people work closely together and quickly get to know many new people through shifts and social events.
No prior knowledge is required to do well here. New volunteers also get the training they need from day one in the kitchen.

detailSections.title: Time commitment
paragraphs: In most sub-groups, the workload is around one shift per week. Shifts are spread across day, evening and weekends, with longer opening hours on weekends.
Halvtimen is an exception and is organized as three shifts per month.
The most common first step is a non-binding trial shift, so that you can try the tasks, meet the people and see whether the environment fits.

detailSections.title: Stjernesalen
paragraphs: Stjernesalen is the house café. Here you work with food service, coffee, cakes, mocktails and wine in a calmer, guest-facing environment.

detailSections.title: Kokkegruppen
paragraphs: Kokkegruppen works in Kvarteret's own kitchen and is for people who want to learn or use food-related skills in a creative and social environment.
The work ranges from serving the house's guests to catering for larger events, parties and concerts.

detailSections.title: Halvtimen
paragraphs: Halvtimen is Kvarteret's cocktail bar. You need to be at least 20 years old, and the environment is especially well suited if you want to learn more about cocktails, flavours and presentation.

detailSections.title: Grøndahls
paragraphs: Grøndahls is the pub with high tempo and a broad selection. It is a good fit if you enjoy operations, flow and a lot of contact with both guests and other volunteers.

LaunchGroups.name: Kraft
LaunchGroups.lead: Kraftetaten is Kvarteret's sound and lighting crew. Here you run technical production for concerts, theatre, debates and other events, and work with equipment that matches professional standards while giving room for learning and networking.

accordionSections.title: What you do
paragraphs: As a krafter, you help plan and run technical production on one of Bergen's strongest intimate stages.
You can try everything from concerts and debates to larger productions and streaming, and most people start by focusing on either sound or lights.

accordionSections.title: Time commitment
paragraphs: The minimum is one shift per week, with many events to choose from.
Mondays are used for house work, maintenance, courses and social time, and new members go through a trial period before a regular contract.

detailSections.title: About the group
paragraphs: Kraftetaten is Kvarteret's sound and lighting crew. Here you run the technical side of concerts, theatre productions, debates and other events that should look and sound their best.
As a volunteer, you get access to a large and modern equipment pool, including streaming gear, and a culture where learning is central.
No prior experience is required. The group is a great fit for people who are creative, practical, outgoing and motivated to learn.

detailSections.title: What a krafter does
paragraphs: As a krafter, you help plan and run the technical side of one of Bergen's best intimate stages, and at the same time meet experienced technicians who contribute both networks and new ways of working.
The work goes beyond concerts. There is also room for theatre, debates, TV-like productions and other larger and smaller events in the house.
Kraftetaten is split into sound and lights. Many people combine them later on, but it is recommended to start with one main track during the first semester.

detailSections.title: Time commitment
paragraphs: As a volunteer in Kraftetaten, you work a minimum of one shift per week, and there are usually several events every day to choose from.
Monday evenings are used for house work, maintenance, training, courses and the social side that builds the group.
New members enter a trial period with a temporary internal ID before a regular volunteer contract is considered.

LaunchGroups.name: Vaktetaten
LaunchGroups.lead: Vaktetaten is Kvarteret's security and steward team. Here you always work together with others, learn conflict management, first aid and fire safety, and help create safety and well-being for both volunteers and guests in the house.

accordionSections.title: What you learn
paragraphs: Vaktetaten provides in-house training in conflict management, first aid and fire safety.
There are also opportunities to take steward and security courses through the group.

accordionSections.title: Time commitment
paragraphs: Shifts are usually three per month, and you can group them into a weekend or spread them out.
It starts with a non-binding trial shift, so the threshold for trying the environment is low.

detailSections.title: About the group
paragraphs: Vaktetaten is Kvarteret's steward and security team. The main task is to safeguard the safety and well-being of both volunteers and guests in the house.
As a guard, you never work alone, which makes the group a close-knit environment where people get to know each other both internally and across the house.

The work is about more than access control. Vaktetaten helps ensure that laws and rules are followed, carries responsibility for fire safety and also staffs stage-security duties during larger events.

detailSections.title: Training and role
paragraphs: The group provides training in conflict management, first aid and fire safety, and also opens the door to steward and security courses.
No prior experience is required. The group looks for people who are calm, composed, decisive, fair, responsible and social.

detailSections.title: Time commitment
paragraphs: As a guard, you work three shifts per month and largely choose when to take them.
Shifts are mainly on Thursdays and on Friday and Saturday evenings and nights, and they can be taken together or spread throughout the month.
If you are curious, you simply start with a non-binding trial shift.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: Skjenkegruppen
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: We run Kvarteret's permanent serving points and help create the atmosphere in the house. With us, you can do everything from pouring exotic beer in Grøndahls, making coffee art and serving sweet and savoury food in Stjernesalen, to shaking heavenly cocktails in Halvtimen. Existing knowledge is always welcome, but if you are open to learning tricks and tips, we are ready to help.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: Vaktetaten
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: We make sure that Kvarteret's guests and volunteers are safe while they are in the house. We focus on situation handling, and our volunteers receive both steward courses and internal training. With us, you experience the night from another side.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: Kraftetaten
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: We run sound and lights for Kvarteret's events and have a large equipment pool to play with. Kvarteret has one of the country's best intimate stages, and with us you can run technical production for concerts, theatre, revue and debates.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: Kokkegruppen
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: Kokkegruppen is technically part of Skjenkegruppen, but for people who love food. Here you learn basic kitchen skills, such as how the classic Stjerneburger is made. You also get creative freedom to bake something tasty for the café. Whether you are a beginner or already skilled in the kitchen, you are very welcome with us. You get all the training you need.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: E-tjenesten
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: E-tjenesten is the IT group at Det Akademiske Kvarter. The group runs and develops Kvarteret's websites and our internal databases. The tasks are varied and cover both frontend and backend. The IT group is a social bunch where you learn easily from and together with others.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: PR-etaten
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: We make sure Kvarteret is visible everywhere. We have sub-groups for social media, graphic design and photography. We run our social channels, document everything happening in the house, create advertising plans for digital surfaces, write press releases and design all printed material. Here you learn marketing in practice.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: Produksjonavdelingene
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: We are behind Kvarteret's own programmes during the semester. There is room for new ideas here both on weekdays and weekends. The tasks are varied, and Studentbergen is waiting with anticipation. The production department consists of three sub-groups: the Quiz group, the DJ group and the Event group.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: Personalgruppen
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: Personalgruppen is responsible for social highlights, recruitment, card production, and course and competence initiatives in the house. The group consists of a board and Kvarteret's own bands, Villa People, who gladly perform at internal parties and other events. To join Personalgruppen, you must have been active in Kvarteret or an affiliated operating or member organization for at least one semester.

VolunteerGroupSummaries.name: Rettsvesenet
VolunteerGroupSummaries.description: Rettsvesenet is a group of law students who assist Det Akademiske Kvarter with legal advice. As a member of Rettsvesenet, you gain useful experience that will help both in your studies and later in working life. Through Rettsvesenet, you also get to know students from other years of study. The role combines well with both studies and part-time work. We are many case handlers, so the workload is shared well, but there is still enough work for everyone to try themselves in the role.
